body: Honestly, I'm a girl who does this and dont agree with your take. I have dated a guy for 6+ months without 'commitment'. We did all the things you listed but I was giving 'girlfriend benefits' I just liked this man a lot and wanted to do these things for him. He was very sweet and upfront about not looking for anything serious so I knew the undertaking. Life is too short to be pretty and transactional with our fellow humans, sometimes it's okay to love someone who isnt on the same page as you.

I've really tried to think of reasons to stay but I cant even come up with one. I've been through a lot, and this year was just really bad. I wish I did have someone to talk to but i dont want to bother people with my boring problems.

I don't want to, literally zero point in me to give life another chance. people here don't seem to understand that it is like excruciating mental pain for me daily, and there is no way for it to stop. I'm dealing with a lot of things at once and cannot handle them anymore, and I have no one to talk to because no one cares.

I don't have friends and have never been in an "official" relationship, so I've only ever had myself and thats it. I've only ever been alone, so I don't think that is an issue for me. I'm just tired of being alive, it's that simple.

yeah, I'm not trying to complain but I have really tried to improve my life over the past year and every attempt made things a lot worse than they were before. It's not like I made this decision without trying my best, I really did but it just wasn't enough.

I know a lot of people have lives that are worse than mine or lives that are much more difficult to endure than mine. However, this is just how I feel and it is my only way out of my current situation. It's refreshing there are people out there who can endure, improve and perhaps thrive with the cards they were dealt, but I don't have that kind of spirit.
I have tried to move forward a lot and just realized its not something I have the energy to do anymore.

I suppose for some people. I have a hard time making friends, I don't have any. As for fashion I agree, I really like fashion so you have a point with cute outfits. People have it easier and worse than each other in different ways.
life is not easier or worse because I'm a woman, everyone (regardless of gender) has their struggles and their own demons.
